about: Primary sources that back claims on agsist.com. scripts/fetch_refs.py (run by .github/workflows/refs.yml) downloads each one to the references branch: refs/<id>.pdf or .html, refs/<id>.txt, index.json. That branch is never deployed. Read a source with: git fetch origin references && git show origin/references:refs/<id>.txt
